ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 11 overnight screening runs with unanimous high conviction — the strongest consensus signal in today's digest. The stock enters a 25-day runway into its August 26 Q2 FY2027 earnings print as the final major AI infrastructure bellwether of the season, with a freshly signed $500B+ Nvidia–SK Group AI infrastructure pact (July 31) providing near-term fundamental momentum. A defined-risk call spread (Aug 29 or Sep expiry) is the preferred structure to capture pre-earnings IV expansion while managing downside in a risk-off tape (Fear & Greed ~37).
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings report: August 26, 2026 after market close
ideas.edge: Consensus EPS $2.07–$2.09; Data Center revenue expected >$80B vs. Q1's $75.2B (+6%+); 68 analysts avg target $302.73 vs ~$202.78 current price (~49% implied upside gap); upward EPS revisions +6.69% over past 3 months; ~25 days of pre-earnings IV expansion runway remaining
ideas.bull_case: Data Center revenue beats the $80B bar, hyperscaler capex commentary remains bullish, and the $500B SK Group pact signals sustained multi-year demand — stock re-rates sharply toward the $300+ analyst consensus and options capture both the IV run-up and the post-earnings gap.
ideas.bear_case: Elevated IV makes options expensive, a guidance-in-line or modest beat could disappoint a high-expectations market, and broad Nasdaq weakness (down ~9.7% since June) could cap any rally; a miss on gross margin guidance would be particularly damaging.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (Nasdaq ADR)
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 11 overnight screening runs and is retesting its $149 IPO price floor after a sentiment-driven ~10% post-earnings selloff — despite posting 51% sequential revenue growth, 76% operating margin, and 103.85% YoY EPS growth. The selloff appears to be an expectations-driven reset rather than a fundamental deterioration, with the $500B+ Nvidia–SK Group AI infrastructure pact (July 31) locking in multi-year HBM demand and CEO commentary projecting HBM shortages lasting beyond 2030. A swing entry near IPO support offers a favorable risk/reward with the South Korean presidential San Francisco visit as an imminent near-term contract catalyst.
ideas.catalyst: South Korean president's San Francisco visit (imminent) expected to catalyze additional large U.S. tech memory contracts; structural HBM4 supply lock-in with NVDA via $500B+ pact signed July 31
ideas.edge: Stock at ~$143–149, at or below $149 IPO price support; ROIC ~73.5%; revenue tripled YoY; Q2 revenue missed by ~6% on expectations (not fundamentals); UBS flagged as bullish; HBM structural monopoly with NVDA intact; newly listed ADR — verify options availability
ideas.bull_case: IPO support holds, U.S. tech contract announcements materialize around the presidential visit, and the market re-rates SKHY on its structural HBM monopoly and the NVDA pact — stock recovers toward and through pre-earnings levels with multi-year AI memory demand as a durable tailwind.
ideas.bear_case: As a newly listed ADR with high beta in a risk-off tape, SKHY could break IPO support if broad market weakness intensifies or if U.S.-South Korea trade/geopolitical tensions resurface; the 6% revenue miss may signal further estimate cuts.

ideas.name: Apple Inc.
ideas.thesis: AAPL appeared in 10 of 11 overnight screening runs following a post-earnings ~10% selloff — the worst post-earnings drop since 2013 — driven by a Q4 gross margin guide miss (47-48%) and a chip supply warning, despite beating on EPS ($2.02) and revenue ($109.4B). The selloff appears supply-constrained and temporary rather than demand-driven, with an intact Buy consensus across 30+ analysts and a street-high target of $400 (TD Cowen). With a CEO transition (Tim Cook → John Ternus, Sept 1) and iPhone 18/foldable cycle ahead, options (defined-risk call spread, 30-45 DTE) are preferred over stock while near-term direction resolves.
ideas.catalyst: iPhone 18 cycle + foldable launch (Fall 2026); AI Siri China launch; CEO transition September 1 (Tim Cook → John Ternus); next earnings October 29, 2026; NFP August 7 as near-term consumer sentiment read
ideas.edge: Stock down ~9-10% to ~$308–333 range; MarketBeat consensus target $329.74 (~5-7% above current), TD Cowen street-high $400 (~20-29% above current); EPS beat at $2.02; >$130B annual FCF provides valuation floor; 50-day EMA support being tested; guidance miss attributed to temporary memory supply constraints
ideas.bull_case: Memory supply constraints resolve quickly, iPhone 18 launch drives a typical upgrade cycle re-rating, and AI Siri China approval provides an incremental demand unlock — stock recovers to $329+ consensus target ahead of October earnings.
ideas.bear_case: CEO transition risk (Tim Cook → Ternus) introduces execution uncertainty; gross margin guide of 47-48% could compress further if chip costs remain elevated; at ~35x FY2026 EPS, valuation remains stretched if the iPhone 18 cycle disappoints or China headwinds persist.
